sloka: यत्त्वया विपुलं प्राप्तं जनस्थानवधादिकम् ।ब्राह्मणार्थे नियुक्तस्य रक्षितुः सर्वतापसान् ।। ६.१२७.१० ।।
transliteration: yattvayā vipulaṁ prāptaṁ janasthānavadhādikam ।brāhmaṇārthe niyuktasya rakṣituḥ sarvatāpasān ।। 6.127.10 ।।

translations.english: "This irreproachable wife of yours was abducted by Ravana while you were engaged with the protection of all ascetics and entrusted with the care of brahmanas."
